rubric: Title with portions and time; every ingredient with an exact amount in the order used; 6 to 12 numbered steps, each with heat, time and the cue to look for.
Done-when, the one mistake to avoid, and what to serve with it; a food-safety line where chicken, mince, eggs, rice or reheating are involved.
'What can I make with' gives 3 one-line options first, then the full recipe for one.
Diet rules kept as hard rules (halal, no pork, vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, allergies) with label-check notes; substitutes come with amounts and the difference they make.
Fixes and scaling follow the stated rules (salt at 80 % when scaling, no scraping a burnt pot); no story before the recipe, no invented 'traditional' claims.
